High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble MenuLayer API.

A MenuLayer displays a scrollable list of menu items organized into sections. It provides callbacks for rendering cells, headers, and handling selection.

proc drawBasicCell(ctx: ptr GContext; cellLayer: ptr Layer; title: cstring;
                   subtitle: cstring = nil; icon: ptr GBitmap = nil) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Draw a basic menu cell with optional subtitle and icon. This is a convenience wrapper around menu_cell_basic_draw.

Parameters:

  • ctx: Graphics context
  • cellLayer: The cell layer to draw into
  • title: Primary text for the cell
  • subtitle: Secondary text (optional)
  • icon: Icon bitmap (optional)

Example:

drawBasicCell(gctx, cellLayer, "Settings".cstring, nil, nil)

proc drawBasicHeader(ctx: ptr GContext; cellLayer: ptr Layer; title: cstring) {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Draw a basic menu section header. This is a convenience wrapper around menu_cell_basic_header_draw.

Parameters:

  • ctx: Graphics context
  • cellLayer: The header layer to draw into
  • title: Header text

Example:

drawBasicHeader(gctx, cellLayer, "Main Section".cstring)
